notes.title: Gaming Strategy
notes.content:
Tips for new players to quickly upgrade
1: Main quest
It is definitely the source of early experience. Players just need to follow the system's instructions when entering. While upgrading their own levels, they can also obtain a lot of props and equipment rewards.
2: Hundred Ghosts
Daily activities opened after level 50. Players who want to gain experience need to complete them every day. If your lineup is relatively weak, you can summon your friends to form a team together. Although the benefits are considerable, it still takes a long time.
3: Sect quest
Activities opened after level 65. The benefits of this task are still good, but the experience given is slightly lower than the previous two.
4: Taixu Fantasy
The gameplay after level 70 is equivalent to a large dungeon in the later stage. The monsters in it are relatively powerful. Players can gain a lot of experience from it, and even top equipment.
